request_text_excerpt: COUNT — VIOLATION OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC RECORDS ACT (Gov. Code § 7920.000 et seq.) Petitioner incorporates the preceding allegations. On October 7, 2025, Petitioner submitted CPRA Request No. 25-2410 to the City of Berkeley. The request sought existing public records concerning expenditures, invoices, staff-time records, internal cost allocations, enforcement-related costs, resource-use communications, and legal or consultant fees associated with Petitioner's ADA matters, CPRA requests, fines, billing notices, and related administrative actions.
